description: Primary literature, preprints, datasets, methods, and correction status. Plus the education-statistics feature's institution statistics (US IPEDS by UNITID, ETER by ETER ID) and country education and R&D indicators (UNESCO UIS, OECD Education at a Glance and Eurostat R&D through the SDMX connector), each value with its definition, unit, reference period and release vintage. Plus the life-sciences reference sources: UniProtKB proteins, NCBI Gene and Taxonomy records, RCSB PDB structures and ChEMBL targets, compounds, activities and documents for a declared bounded set, each record with its source release and version marker.
